An illegal '''mining facility''' was located in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Guineo]] criminal named [[Yol Areebi]] provided the facility with natives of the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Endor/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] for [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor.
